address: 8, Lane 28, Shuangcheng Street, Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: Tucked away in a quiet alley, the reputation of Inn’s+ is entirely word of mouth. The owner-chef, who used to manage a bistro, re-interprets Taiwanese classics with less fat and less sodium for a health-conscious clientele, without sacrificing flavour or freshness. Her signature baby oyster omelette uses plump, creamy bivalves from Chiayi County, as well as free-range chicken eggs that boast rich flavours. Tailored menus possible for large parties.
